title: A mattress by the ditch
body: The woman had been sleeping beside a field where the trial sprayers passed at dawn. She moved her bedding when the smell reached it, but the pale film returned overnight. Nobody in camp had seen a warning sign.
rival_reading: The containment response might explain a contaminated object or warning being displaced.
gloss: A witness records evidence of exposure near treated land.
